headline: The Southborough School Committee appointed educators Craig Williams and Heather McCloud to the town's Elementary School Building Committee.
synopsis: During a brief special meeting this week, the Southborough School Committee finalized its two appointments to the five-member Elementary School Building Committee. The committee voted unanimously to select active educators Craig Williams and Heather McCloud for the Neary School project. These positions join three members previously designated by the Select Board. Committee members noted the importance of incorporating current operational, classroom, and special education perspectives into the planning process.

highlights.title: Appointments to Elementary School Building Committee
highlights.why: The committee voted 3-0 to appoint active educators Craig Williams and Heather McCloud to fill its two designated seats on the committee overseeing the Neary School project.
